column3: Ecclesiae tuae, quæsumus, Domine, dona propitius intuere, quibus non iam aurum, thus et myrrha profertur, sed quod eisdem muneribus declaratur, immolatur et sumitur, Iesus Christus. Qui vivit et regnat in sæcula saeculorum.
Ecce tabernaculum Dei cum hominibus! Et habitabit cum eis, et ipsi populus eius erunt, et ipse Deus cum eis erit eorum Deus (T.P. alleluia).
See, God's dwelling stands among mankind! He will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God (Easter Time: alleluia).
Salve, sancta parens, enixa puerpera Regem, qui caelum terramque regit in sæcula saeculorum.
Hail, holy Mother, who brought forth in childbirth the King who rules heaven and earth for ages upon ages.
Beata viscera Mariae Virginis, quae portaverunt aeterni Patris Filium.
Blessed is the womb of the Virgin Mary, which bore the Son of the eternal Father.
Beata es, Virgo Maria, quae omnium portasti creatorem; genuisti qui te fecit, et in aeternum permanes Virgo.
Blessed are you, Virgin Mary, who carried the Creator of all things; you gave birth to him who made you, and you remain a Virgin for ever.
Concede, misericors Deus, fragilitati nostrae praesidium, ut, qui sanctae Dei Genetricis memoriam agimus, intercessionis eius auxilio a nostris iniquitatibus resurgamus. Per Dominum.
Grant, O merciful God, a safeguard to our frailty, that we who keep the memory of the holy Mother of God may by the help of her intercession rise up from our iniquities. Through our Lord.
Virgo Dei Genetrix, quem totus non capit orbis, in tua se clausit viscera factus homo.
Virgin Mother of God, he whom the whole world cannot contain enclosed himself within your womb and became man.
Beata viscera Mariae Virginis, quae portaverunt aeterni Patris Filium.
Blessed is the womb of the Virgin Mary, which bore the Son of the eternal Father.
Ecce merces Sanctorum copiosa est apud Deum: ipsi vero mortui sunt pro Christo, et vivent in aeternum.
Behold, the reward of the Saints is abundant with God: they died for Christ, and they shall live for ever.
Propter testamentum Domini et leges paternas, Sancti Dei perstiterunt in amore fraternitatis: quia unus fuit semper spiritus in eis, et una fides.
For the covenant of the Lord and the laws of their fathers, the Saints of God stood firm in brotherly love: for one spirit was always in them, and one faith.
Iustorum animae in manu Dei sunt: et non tanget illos tormentum malitiae. Visi sunt oculis insipientium mori: illi autem sunt in pace.
The souls of the just are in the hand of God, and no torment of malice shall touch them. In the sight of the foolish they seemed to die, yet they are in peace.
Vestri capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt; nolite timere: multis passeribus meliores estis vos.
All the hairs of your head have been numbered; do not be afraid: you are worth more than many sparrows.
Iste sanctus pro lege Dei sui certavit usque ad mortem, et a verbis impiorum non timuit; fundatus enim erat supra firmam petram.
This saint strove even to death for the law of his God and did not fear the words of the wicked, for he was founded upon firm rock.
Qui sequitur me, non ambulat in tenebris, sed habebit lumen vitae, dicit Dominus.
Whoever follows me does not walk in darkness, but will possess the light of life, says the Lord.
Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter iustitiam, quoniam ipsorum est regnum caelorum (T.P. alleluia).
Blessed are those who suffer persecution for the sake of justice, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to them (Easter Time: alleluia).
Istarum est enim regnum caelorum quae contempserunt vitam mundi, et pervenerunt ad præmia regni et laverunt stolas suas in sanguine Agni (T.P. alleluia).
The kingdom of heaven belongs to those women who despised the life of this world, attained the rewards of the kingdom, and washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb (Easter Time: alleluia).
Pastor bonus animam suam posuit pro ovibus suis (T.P. alleluia).
The good shepherd laid down his life for his sheep (Easter Time: alleluia).
Domine, tu omnia nosti; tu scis quia amo te (T.P. alleluia).
Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you (Easter Time: alleluia).
Beatus ille servus, quem, cum venerit dominus eius, et pulsaverit ianuam, invenerit vigilantem (T.P. alleluia).
Blessed is that servant whom his master, when he comes and knocks at the door, finds keeping watch (Easter Time: alleluia).
Dabo vobis pastores iuxta cor meum, et pascent vos scientia et doctrina (T.P. alleluia).
I will give you shepherds after my own heart, and they shall feed you with knowledge and teaching (Easter Time: alleluia).
Filius hominis non venit ministrari, sed ministrare, et dare animam suam redemptionem pro multis (T.P. alleluia).
The Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many (Easter Time: alleluia).
Sacerdotes tui, Domine, induant iustitiam, et sancti tui exsultent (T.P. alleluia).
Let your priests, O Lord, be clothed with justice, and let your holy ones rejoice (Easter Time: alleluia).
Beatus servus, quem, cum venerit Dominus, invenerit vigilantem; amen dico vobis, super omnia bona sua constituet eum (T.P. alleluia).
Blessed is the servant whom the Lord, when he comes, finds keeping watch; truly I tell you, he will set him over all his possessions (Easter Time: alleluia).
Fidelis servus et prudens, quem constituit Dominus super familiam suam, ut det illis in tempore tritici mensuram (T.P. alleluia).
This is the faithful and wise steward whom the Lord set over his household to give them their measure of grain in due season (Easter Time: alleluia).
Spiritus Domini super me: propter quod unxit me, evangelizare pauperibus misit me, sanare contritos corde (T.P. alleluia).
The Spirit of the Lord is upon me: therefore he has anointed me; he has sent me to proclaim good news to the poor and to heal the brokenhearted (Easter Time: alleluia).
Isti sunt viri sancti, quos elegit Dominus in caritate non ficta; et dedit illis gloriam sempiternam, quorum doctrina fulget Ecclesia (T.P. alleluia).
These are the holy men whom the Lord chose in unfeigned charity and to whom he gave everlasting glory, by whose teaching the Church shines bright (Easter Time: alleluia).
Ego pascam oves meas, et ego eas accubare faciam, dicit Dominus (T.P. alleluia).
I myself will pasture my sheep, and I myself will bring them to rest, says the Lord (Easter Time: alleluia).
Quam pulchri super montes pedes annuntiantis et praedicantis pacem, annuntiantis bonum, praedicantis salutem (T.P. alleluia)!
How lovely upon the mountains are the feet of the herald proclaiming and preaching peace, proclaiming good news and preaching salvation (Easter Time: alleluia)!
Os iusti meditabitur sapientiam, et lingua eius loquetur iudicium; lex Dei eius in corde ipsius (T.P. alleluia).
The mouth of the just person will ponder wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment; the law of his God is within his heart (Easter Time: alleluia).
Fidelis servus et prudens, quem constituit Dominus super familiam suam, ut det illis in tempore tritici mensuram (T.P. alleluia).
This is the faithful and wise steward whom the Lord set over his household to give them their measure of grain in due season (Easter Time: alleluia).
Qui meditabitur in lege Domini die ac nocte, dabit fructum suum in tempore suo (T.P. alleluia).
Whoever meditates on the law of the Lord day and night will yield his fruit in due season (Easter Time: alleluia).
Ecce Sponsus venit: exite obviam Christo Domino (T.P. alleluia).
Behold, the Bridegroom is coming: go out to meet Christ the Lord (Easter Time: alleluia).
Unam petii a Domino, hanc requiram: ut inhabitem in domo Domini omnibus diebus vitae meae (T.P. alleluia).
One thing I have asked of the Lord, this I will seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life (Easter Time: alleluia).
Quinque prudentes virgines acceperunt oleum in vasis suis cum lampadibus. Media autem nocte clamor factus est: Ecce sponsus venit, exite obviam Christo Domino (T.P. alleluia).
Five wise virgins took oil in their flasks together with their lamps. At midnight a cry went up: Behold, the Bridegroom is coming; go out to meet Christ the Lord (Easter Time: alleluia).
Veni, sponsa Christi, accipe coronam, quam tibi Dominus praeparavit in aeternum (T.P. alleluia).
Come, bride of Christ, receive the crown which the Lord has prepared for you for ever (Easter Time: alleluia).
Media nocte clamor factus est: Ecce sponsus venit, exite obviam ei (T.P. alleluia).
At midnight a cry went up: Behold, the Bridegroom is coming; go out to meet him (Easter Time: alleluia).
Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnia opera tua, et Sancti tui benedicant tibi: gloriam regni tui dicent, et potentiam tuam loquentur (T.P. alleluia).
Let all your works give thanks to you, O Lord, and let your Saints bless you: they shall speak of the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power (Easter Time: alleluia).
Iusti epulentur, et exsultent in conspectu Dei, et delectentur in laetitia (T.P. alleluia).
Let the just feast and exult in the sight of God, and delight in gladness (Easter Time: alleluia).
Beati servi illi, quos, cum venerit Dominus, invenerit vigilantes. Amen dico vobis, quod praecinget se, et faciet illos discumbere, et transiens ministrabit illis (T.P. alleluia).

Blessed are those servants whom the Lord, when he comes, finds keeping watch. Truly I tell you, he will gird himself, have them recline at table, and pass along to wait upon them (Easter Time: alleluia).
Laetabitur iustus in Domino, et sperabit in eo; et laudabuntur omnes recti corde (T.P. alleluia).
The just person will rejoice in the Lord and place his hope in him; and all the upright of heart shall be praised (Easter Time: alleluia).

Benedictus vir, qui confidit in Domino, et erit Dominus fiducia eius; et erit quasi lignum, quod transplantatur super aquas, quod ad humorem mittit radices suas; et non timebit cum venerit aestus (T.P. alleluia).

Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord will be his confidence; he shall be like a tree transplanted beside waters, sending its roots toward the moisture, and he shall not fear when heat comes (Easter Time: alleluia).
In virtute tua, Domine, laetabitur iustus, et super salutare tuum exsultabit vehementer; desiderium animae eius tribuisti ei (T.P. alleluia).
In your strength, O Lord, the just one will rejoice, and in your saving help he will exult exceedingly; you have granted him his soul's desire (Easter Time: alleluia).
Lex veritatis fuit in ore eius et iniquitas non est inventa in labiis eius; in pace et in aequitate ambulavit mecum, et multos avertit ab iniquitate (T.P. alleluia).
The law of truth was in his mouth, and no iniquity was found upon his lips; he walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity (Easter Time: alleluia).
Beati mundo corde, quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt; beati pacifici, quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur (T.P. alleluia).
Blessed are the clean of heart, for they shall see God; blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God (Easter Time: alleluia).
Os iusti meditabitur sapientiam, et lingua eius loquetur iudicium; lex Dei eius in corde ipsius (T.P. alleluia).
The mouth of the just person will ponder wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment; the law of his God is within his heart (Easter Time: alleluia).
Fidelis servus et prudens, quem constituit Dominus super familiam suam, ut det illis in tempore tritici mensuram (T.P. alleluia).
This is the faithful and wise steward whom the Lord set over his household to give them their measure of grain in due season (Easter Time: alleluia).
Qui verbum Dei retinent corde perfecto et optimo, fructum afferunt in patientia (T.P. alleluia).
Those who keep the word of God with an upright and noble heart bring forth fruit in patience (Easter Time: alleluia).
Ego autem sicut oliva fructifera in domo Dei, speravi in misericordia Dei in aeternum et in sæculum sæculi (T.P. alleluia).
As for me, like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God, I have hoped in God's mercy for ever and for ages of ages (Easter Time: alleluia).
Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum, dico ego opera mea Regi (T.P. alleluia).
My heart has poured forth a noble word; I speak my works to the King (Easter Time: alleluia).
Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus: beatus vir, qui sperat in eo (T.P. alleluia).
Taste and see how sweet the Lord is: blessed is the man who hopes in him (Easter Time: alleluia).
Beati pauperes spiritu, quoniam ipsorum est regnum caelorum (T.P. alleluia).
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to them (Easter Time: alleluia).
Dispersit, dedit pauperibus: iustitia eius manet in sæculum sæculi, cornu eius exaltabitur in gloria (T.P. alleluia).
He has distributed freely and given to the poor: his justice endures for ever and ever; his horn shall be lifted up in glory (Easter Time: alleluia).
Maiorem hac dilectionem nemo habet, ut animam suam ponat quis pro amicis suis (T.P. alleluia).
No one has greater love than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends (Easter Time: alleluia).
Qui sequitur me, non ambulat in tenebris, sed habebit lumen vitae, dicit Dominus (T.P. alleluia).
Whoever follows me does not walk in darkness, but will possess the light of life, says the Lord (Easter Time: alleluia).
Quicumque fecerit voluntatem Patris mei, qui in caelis est, ipse meus frater et soror et mater est, dicit Dominus (T.P. alleluia).
Whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, that one is my brother and sister and mother, says the Lord (Easter Time: alleluia).
Deus, qui nos resurrectionis dominicae annua sollemnitate laetificas, concede propitius, ut, per temporalia festa quae agimus, pervenire ad gaudia aeterna mereamur. Per Dominum.
O God, who gladden us by the annual solemnity of the Lord's resurrection, graciously grant that through the temporal feasts we celebrate we may merit to attain eternal joys. Through our Lord.
